runs.text:
Munknörr is a project of Nordic and Celtic music with Shamanic elements created by composer and producer Damián Schneider in 2019 . Aethelwyne , a folk singer with a haunting voice from Greece joined the project the same year.
About the word…Munknörr means “the ship of the mind” in old norse.
Seeking for a pagan sound with a mystic vibe Munknörr´s compositions try to get closer to a natural primitive sound.
